title: Check Overall System Statistics Main Statistics (Core system statistics) and select statistics types (E-stop, Volume)
summary: Use the HMI view labeled "Overall System Statistics" to confirm the "Main Statistics" area is showing "Core system statistics" and to identify which "Types of Statistics" is currently selected: "Estop" (E stops) or "Volume" (Total Exchanges, To Tipper, To Hospital).
when_to_use: When you need to verify what "Main Statistics" ("Core system statistics") is currently displaying and determine whether the "Types of Statistics" view is showing "Estop" (E stops) or "Volume" categories (Total Exchanges, To Tipper, To Hospital).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the "Overall System Statistics" HMI view and visually confirm the "Main Statistics" and the currently selected "Types of Statistics" (Estop vs Volume).
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the HMI screen "Overall System Statistics"
Visual access to the "Main Statistics" and "Types of Statistics" sections

access_required: HMI access to the "Overall System Statistics" view

visual_references.description: Frame showing "Overall System Statistics" with "Main Statistics: Core system statistics" and "Types of Statistics" including "Estop" and "Volume (Total Exchanges, To Tipper, To Hospital)".

steps.title: Open the HMI view labeled "Overall System Statistics" and navigate to the "Main Statistics" area
steps.purpose: To reach the "Main Statistics" section so you can confirm it is showing "Core system statistics".
steps.instruction: On the HMI, open the view labeled "Overall System Statistics" and navigate to the "Main Statistics" area.
steps.expected_result: The "Main Statistics" area is visible and shows "Core system statistics".
steps.healthy_condition: "Main Statistics" displays the label "Core system statistics" in the "Overall System Statistics" view.
steps.failure_condition: The "Overall System Statistics" view or the "Main Statistics" area is not visible.

actions.label: Open Overall System Statistics
actions.exact_action: Open the HMI view labeled "Overall System Statistics" and navigate to the "Main Statistics" area.

stop_or_escalate_if: If "Overall System Statistics" or the "Main Statistics" area is not visible, stop and escalate to support for guidance on where the view is located in the HMI.

steps.title: Confirm "Main Statistics" is shown as "Core system statistics"
steps.purpose: To verify you are looking at the correct "Main Statistics" content.
steps.instruction: Visually confirm that the "Main Statistics" content reads "Core system statistics".
steps.expected_result: The "Main Statistics" area explicitly shows "Core system statistics".
steps.healthy_condition: "Main Statistics" label "Core system statistics" is readable in the "Overall System Statistics" view.
steps.failure_condition: "Main Statistics" does not show "Core system statistics" (or the label is not readable).

actions.label: Verify Core system statistics label
actions.exact_action: Confirm the "Main Statistics" content is shown as "Core system statistics".

stop_or_escalate_if: If the "Main Statistics" area cannot be confirmed as "Core system statistics", stop and escalate to support for guidance on where the view is located in the HMI.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide shows "Main Statistics: Core system statistics".

source_evidence.retrieval_text: Training video slide frame captured at 02:10:40.000. Transcript near this frame: You have your main statistics, you have your tippers E stops volume, number of exchanges to tipper to hospital.

steps.title: Locate the "Types of Statistics" list/selector on the same screen
steps.purpose: To find the control that determines whether you are viewing "Estop" or "Volume" statistics.
steps.instruction: On the same "Overall System Statistics" screen, locate the "Types of Statistics" list/selector.
steps.expected_result: The "Types of Statistics" list/selector is visible on the "Overall System Statistics" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: "Types of Statistics" is visible and shows options including "Estop" and "Volume".
steps.failure_condition: "Types of Statistics" list/selector is not visible.

actions.label: Find Types of Statistics selector
actions.exact_action: Locate the "Types of Statistics" list/selector on the "Overall System Statistics" screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the "Types of Statistics" selector is not visible, stop and escalate to support for guidance on where the view is located in the HMI.

steps.title: Verify the currently selected statistics type is "Estop" or "Volume"
steps.purpose: To determine which statistics category the "Main Statistics" area is currently presenting.
steps.instruction: Check which option under "Types of Statistics" is currently selected. It must be either "Estop" (E stops) or "Volume".
steps.expected_result: The selected statistics type is clearly identifiable as either "Estop" or "Volume".
steps.healthy_condition: You can point to the selected "Types of Statistics" option showing either "Estop" or "Volume".
steps.failure_condition: The selected statistics type cannot be identified as "Estop" or "Volume".

actions.label: Identify selected statistics type
actions.exact_action: Verify the currently selected statistics type is one of: "Estop" or "Volume".

steps.title: If "Volume" is selected, confirm volume categories include "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", and "To Hospital"
steps.purpose: To confirm the correct "Volume" breakdown is being displayed.
steps.instruction: If "Volume" is selected under "Types of Statistics", confirm the volume categories shown include "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", and "To Hospital".
steps.expected_result: The "Volume" view shows categories "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", and "To Hospital".
steps.healthy_condition: All three category labels are visible under the "Volume" statistics type.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the categories "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", or "To Hospital" are missing from the "Volume" view.

actions.label: Verify Volume categories
actions.exact_action: Confirm the volume categories shown include "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", and "To Hospital".

steps.title: If "Estop" is selected, confirm the screen is presenting "E stops" statistics for tippers
steps.purpose: To confirm the "Estop" statistics type is showing the expected E-stop context (tippers E stops).
steps.instruction: If "Estop" is selected under "Types of Statistics", confirm the screen is presenting "E stops" statistics for tippers.
steps.expected_result: The "Estop" view is presenting E-stop statistics for tippers.
steps.healthy_condition: The displayed statistics correspond to "E stops" for tippers (as indicated by the "Estop" statistics type in the "Overall System Statistics" view).
steps.failure_condition: The "Estop" view does not appear to be showing E-stop statistics for tippers.

actions.label: Verify Estop context
actions.exact_action: Confirm the screen is presenting "E stops" statistics for tippers.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: "tippers E stops"; OCR shows "Types of Statistics" includes "Estop".

success_criteria: The "Main Statistics" area shows "Core system statistics".
The "Types of Statistics" selection is identifiable as either "Estop" or "Volume".
If "Volume" is selected, the categories "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", and "To Hospital" are present.
If "Estop" is selected, the view is presenting "E stops" statistics for tippers.
healthy_conditions: "Overall System Statistics" screen is visible with "Main Statistics: Core system statistics".
"Types of Statistics" shows options including "Estop" and "Volume (Total Exchanges, To Tipper, To Hospital)".
failure_conditions: "Overall System Statistics" or "Main Statistics" area is not visible.
"Types of Statistics" selector is not visible.
Selected statistics type is not clearly "Estop" or "Volume".
If "Volume" is selected, one or more of the categories "Total Exchanges", "To Tipper", "To Hospital" are missing.
If "Estop" is selected, the view does not appear to be showing tippers E-stop statistics.
escalation_guidance: If "Overall System Statistics" or the "Types of Statistics" selector is not visible, stop and escalate to support for guidance on where the view is located in the HMI.
